title: Reducing cost and improving performance with Claude Platform
summary: Anthropic released guidance for cutting Claude Platform costs without sacrificing performance, including new `/claude-api` skill commands (prompt-audit, hillclimb, cost-optimize) that optimize prompt caching and model configuration. Real-world deployments show 52-73% cost savings possible, with one case achieving 14.6% cost reduction and 5.3% accuracy improvement by removing legacy anti-pattern instructions.

title: Building commerce agents with Claude
summary: Anthropic released a blueprint for production commerce agents covering shopping and merchant roles across retail, travel, telecom, and ticketing. The blueprint is deployable via Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, and Google Cloud Vertex AI, backed by partners including Shopify, Priceline, Visa, and Mastercard; enterprise deployments report 35% larger shopping carts and 60% higher purchase completion rates.

title: A guide to the anatomy of effective commerce agents
summary: Detailed guide on building production-ready commerce agents with Claude, covering architecture, performance patterns, and operations. The guide recommends single-agent architecture with skills, introduces new memory and safety patterns (enforced in code rather than prompts), and releases a GitHub reference implementation achieving 90-99% prompt cache hit rates.

title: How Warp builds self-improving agents on Claude
summary: Warp (800K monthly developer users) demonstrated a self-improving agent pattern using Claude Platform's Agent Skills with a two-skill architecture combining domain knowledge and human-feedback-driven refinement. The approach scales across thousands of specialized code-review agents while keeping humans in control through normal code review processes; Warp runs 400K+ Claude Code sessions weekly.

title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
summary: Claude in Chrome moved from pilot to general availability on all paid Claude plans, enabling Claude to view and act on websites without direct integrations. Autonomous action approval for safe tasks and enhanced three-layer security (adversarial training, content screening, automatic verification) reduce strong prompt-injection attack success from 3.8% to 0%.

title: What 1,000 small business owners taught us about AI
summary: Anthropic's Claude SMB Tour trained 1,000+ small business owners across 10 US cities, following launch of Claude for Small Business with QuickBooks and PayPal integrations. Research found non-technical owners can build custom tools, accuracy and data security dominate adoption barriers, hands-on practice drives engagement, and peer stories matter more than features.
